creator.name: HenxDraws
creator.bio:
Hey there, I'm Henx, a Swedish comic creator — Driven by passion, fuelled by coffee (as most Swedes are).

I'm currently working on:
Life of Light - A fantasy comedy about the magnificent hero, Light, who kinda just don't wanna be a hero.
Astro Hub 5 - Unannounced and mysterious. Available soon on a site near you.

support.title: Enjoying the comic?
support.text:
Want early pages, behind-the-scenes sketches, and more? Just feel like supporting my work?

Join me on Patreon!

comics.title: Astro Hub 5
comics.description: A sci-fi comedy about a station where everything is fine and nothing ever goes wrong.

comics.title: Life of Light
comics.description: A story about a depressed hero, a bubbly cursed knight, and a very smart mascot. Doesn't get better than that.
